crossRefs.note: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding. I have removed…
My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered…

translations.web: ‘Your silver and your gold is mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’ ”
translations.bsb: saying, “This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and your best wives and children are mine!’”
translations.kjv: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
translations.asv: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
